name: visualize
title: Mixdog Visualize
description: Show the user a finished deliverable you produced or changed (mockups, docs, decks, sheets, PDFs, images, video, local dev pages) in the desktop side panel beside the chat. A summary, plan or report of your own work stays in the chat. Your own check screenshots are not deliverables: look at them with read; open with verify: true only to run check/inspect/act/capture/export. Tabs reload when a file changes, so do not re-open after edits. open: input.targets or input.content, optional label, version, verify. close: optional tab. annotate: tab + add | remove | clear; HTML pages only, never edits the file. capture: tab + output. export: tab + format + output, optional version and overwrite; a single HTML page is rendered whole off screen (PDF: HTML pages only; PNG has a pixel cap, over it export pdf), any other tab exports as capture does; paths outside the working directory are refused. check: tab; the page's runtime problems. inspect: tab, optional viewport and selector; a text read-out of the rendered page (landmarks, interactive elements with selectors and boxes, layout findings); run it at desktop and, for responsive designs, a mobile width, and fix the findings before reporting. act: tab + steps (15 s in total), optional pane and output; operates an HTML page with synthetic DOM events and stops at the first failing step. Any result about a tab ends with a "Page problems" section when the page has problems: fix them in the file and re-check; never report a page with unresolved problems as done. HTML pages run their scripts, but outside network is blocked unless the user allows it for the tab, so pages must be self-contained. input.content {kind, source, title?} renders mermaid, svg and markdown (static, sanitized) or chart (ECharts option JSON) and html (scripts run) with no file written, max 512 KiB; a render error is returned as a page problem. Adjustable parameters are declared in an mx-tweaks block (form: the visualize skill's feedback reference). To check a local HTML page, open it here and operate it with act; never serve it yourself to drive it in browser. Returns final results in this call.

targets.description: open: 1-3 file paths (side by side), relative to the working directory or absolute in any folder, or exactly one http(s) URL as the only target.

source.description: Diagram text, SVG/HTML/Markdown source, or an ECharts option as JSON (chart).

title.description: Tab title; re-opening the same title adds a version.

content.description: open: render this directly instead of files. Exclusive with targets.

version.description: open (file tabs): kept version number to show read-only instead of the live files. export: kept version number to render instead of the live page.

verify.description: open (files or content): true to check your own work only; the user is not shown the tab and it closes when the turn ends.

tab.description: Tab id from open (close: omit for all).

output.description: capture: project path ending .png. export: project path ending .png or .pdf (matching format). act: optional project path ending .png for a capture of the final state.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element.

key.description: key: a key or chord, e.g. Enter, Shift+Tab.

x.description: scroll: pixels to the right (negative = left).

timeout.description: wait with selector: longest wait for it to be shown (default 5000).

script.description: evaluate: one JS expression or IIFE; its JSON-serializable result is returned.

steps.description: act: the steps, run in order; the first failure stops the rest.

pane.description: act: the pane (1-based position in the tab) to operate; default the first HTML page.

overwrite.description: export: replace an existing output file; honored only for paths under design/.

viewport.description: inspect: size to lay the page out at (height defaults to 800); omit for the panel's current size.

selector.description: inspect: CSS selector scoping the read-out to one subtree.
